title: Alert limits of automation-workflow.v2 graphs
description: Golden cases: an automation graph and the alert limits read from it (spec 037). The control plane's DeploymentGraph must return exactly `limits`, ordered as here; the runtime's evaluator is probed on the cases that say how. A case with no limits is one that cannot be placed on the reading's own value axis.

workflow.description: An automation-workflow.v2 graph. Cases with no limits may hold steps or units the runtime refuses.

probe.description: How the runtime's evaluator is checked against the limits: `exact` at the value and just either side, `near` just either side only (a conversion was undone), `hysteresis` across both values.

device_uuid.description: The device whose reading is compared.

role.description: Whether crossing the value raises the alert or clears it. `clear` comes only from a hysteresis condition.

operator.description: The side of the value on which the alert is raised, or for `clear` on which it clears, after any inversion.

value.description: In the parameter's own unit; rounded to 10 significant digits when a conversion was undone.

held_seconds.description: How long the condition must hold before the alert is raised.

combined.description: True when the alert also depends on another condition.
